note: One zone per muscle, both sides. Baked per-vertex as _ZONE.

zones.name: Rectus Abdominis
zones.desc: The 'six-pack'; flexes the spine, resists extension. Crunches, leg raises, planks.

zones.name: Adductors
zones.desc: Inner thigh; pulls the legs together, stabilises hips. Adduction, sumo squats.

zones.name: Biceps Brachii
zones.desc: Front of the upper arm; bends the elbow, supinates the forearm. Curls.

zones.name: Gastrocnemius / Calf
zones.desc: Two-headed calf bulge; points the toes (plantarflexion). Standing calf raises.

zones.name: Deltoid
zones.desc: Shoulder cap in three heads; raises the arm every direction. Presses, lateral raises.

zones.name: Erector Spinae
zones.desc: Columns beside the spine; extends and stabilises the back. Deadlifts, back extensions.

zones.name: Forearm
zones.desc: Grip, wrist and finger drivers. Wrist curls, grip work, carries.

zones.name: Gluteus Maximus
zones.desc: Largest muscle; extends the hip, drives power. Squats, hip thrusts, bridges.

zones.name: Hamstrings
zones.desc: Back-thigh group; bends the knee, extends the hip. RDLs, leg curls, deadlifts.

zones.name: Latissimus Dorsi
zones.desc: The 'wings' of the back; pulls the arms down and back. Pull-ups, rows, pulldowns.

zones.name: Neck
zones.desc: Sternocleidomastoid and neck extensors; turns and steadies the head. Neck curls, shrugs, harness work.

zones.name: External Oblique
zones.desc: Flanks of the abdomen; rotates and side-bends the trunk. Twists, side planks.

zones.name: Pectoralis Major
zones.desc: Chest fan; pushes and draws the arm across the body. Bench press, flyes, push-ups.

zones.name: Quadriceps
zones.desc: Front-thigh group of four; straightens the knee. Squats, lunges, leg extensions.

zones.name: Tibialis Anterior
zones.desc: Front of the shin; lifts the foot (dorsiflexion). Toe raises, walks.

zones.name: Trapezius
zones.desc: Upper back & neck yoke; shrugs and stabilises the shoulder blades. Shrugs, face-pulls.

zones.name: Triceps Brachii
zones.desc: Back of the upper arm; straightens the elbow. Dips, pushdowns, overhead extensions.
